pr_body:
Users should be able to enable `CONFIG_KERNEL_SHELL` without `CONFIG_EXCEPTION_STACK_TRACE`, i.e.:

```
west build -b qemu_riscv64 -p auto zephyr/samples/hello_world -- \
  -DCONFIG_SHELL=y \
  -DCONFIG_EXCEPTION_STACK_TRACE=n
```

Compile a weak `arch_stack_walk()` placeholder, which can be replaced by the arch-defined version when the conditions are met.

Fixes #76706

**To Reproduce**
Checkout `main` and build
```
west build -b qemu_riscv64 -p auto zephyr/samples/hello_world -- \
  -DCONFIG_SHELL=y \
  -DCONFIG_EXCEPTION_STACK_TRACE=n
```

review_comments:
We are trying to get rid of weak symbols across the tree, especially for arch_ interfaces, can be done differently, something along the lines of the diff below, i.e. providing empty stubs instead.. 

```diff
--- a/arch/riscv/core/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/arch/riscv/core/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -25,5 +25,5 @@ zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_RISCV_PMP pmp.c pmp.S)

 zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_USERSPACE userspace.S)
 zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_SEMIHOST semihost.c)
-zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_EXCEPTION_STACK_TRACE stacktrace.c)
+zephyr_library_sources(stacktrace.c)
 zephyr_linker_sources(ROM_START SORT_KEY 0x0vectors vector_table.ld)
diff --git a/arch/riscv/core/stacktrace.c b/arch/riscv/core/stacktrace.c
index 23baeca79d1..471de0b76f9 100644
--- a/arch/riscv/core/stacktrace.c
+++ b/arch/riscv/core/stacktrace.c
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 #include <kernel_internal.h>
 #include <zephyr/logging/log.h>

+#if defined(CONFIG_EXCEPTION_STACK_TRACE)
 LOG_MODULE_DECLARE(os, CONFIG_KERNEL_LOG_LEVEL);

 uintptr_t z_riscv_get_sp_before_exc(const struct arch_esf *esf);
@@ -242,3 +243,10 @@ void z_riscv_unwind_stack(const struct arch_esf *esf, const _callee_saved_t *csf
        walk_stackframe(print_trace_address, &i, _current, esf, in_fatal_stack_bound, csf);
        LOG_ERR("");
 }
+#else
+void arch_stack_walk(stack_trace_callback_fn callback_fn, void *cookie,
+                    const struct k_thread *thread, const struct arch_esf *esf)
+{
+}
+
+#endif
```
